jobs.title: Dotnet Developer
jobs.description:
***Full English proficiency required***

Proxima is an American company with offices in Latin America that provides IT and operational services to the insurance industry. We are looking for a Software Engineer for one of our client companies

As a Software Engineer (.Net Developer), you will be responsible for overall product development. You will be managing day-to-day development activities on targeted accounts and/or targeted areas of functionality within a team environment.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:
Develop web applications according to specifications or business requirements.
Ability to analyze business requirements and translate these into web design documents and technical specifications.
Ability to work with a diverse project team, including .Net Developers, Database Developers, QA Staff, Business Analysts, and Project Managers.
Maintain and debug existing web modules.
Perform unit testing of modifications and enhancements to ensure system integrity.
Understands Insuresoft’s products, release schedules, organizational structure and business goals/objectives.
Develops a working knowledge of product, including its configurability options and available functionality.
Utilizes internal defect tracking software as projects are completed and on an ongoing basis as required.
Relies on broad experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals.
Requires a certain degree of creativity or latitude to accomplish position responsibilities.
Performs other duties as assigned.

COMPETENCY & EDUCATION SPECIFICATIONS:
B.A./B.S. in Computer Science or related discipline and/or equivalent, relevant work experience.
Microsoft Developer Certification or graduate degree is a plus!
3+ years experience in the following programming language(s)/operating platforms ~ ASP/ASP.Net, C#, VB.Net, & SQL Server
Documented experience programming in a Windows environment is required.
Knowledge of various software development life cycle models.
Experience working with solutions geared towards the insurance industry preferred.
Excellent organizational, written, and communication skills.
Strong problem solving and analytical skills.
Ability to reason logically and provide solutions.
Strong work ethic and the ability to deliver solutions under deadlines.

ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL DEMANDS:
Works 40+ hours per week.
Availability to be ‘on call’ or work after hours on occasion, as required.

BENEFITS:
Starting salary $2,400/mo, plus benefits
Growth opportunities in an international organization
100% remote work.
